sisi.depan: A huge, open sliding hangar door reveals a view of a clear sky and distant snow-capped mountains.
sisi.kanan: A metal staircase runs up the right wall to a high gantry walkway that extends towards the back of the hangar.
sisi.belakang: The back wall features a large, elevated control-room window set above a set of metallic double doors.
sisi.kiri: The left wall is lined with large, industrial refueling pumps and coiled hoses hanging on wall-mounted brackets.

tengah: A rounded, bus-sized Galians transport dropship with a glossy white hull, purple stripes, and a gold crest of wings flanking a flame circle on its side rests on a circular landing pad outlined with yellow floor markings; its nose points toward the open hangar door and its rear loading ramp is lowered.
atas: High above, the ceiling is a network of steel support beams and girders, with several large, bright industrial floodlights illuminating the space below.
